name: security_analysis
description: Static analysis for security anti-patterns, dependency vulnerabilities, and dangerous API usage. Produces a security_score and an actionable fix list per finding.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Module ID or file path to scan.

inputs.name: severity_threshold
inputs.description: Minimum severity to report: critical | high | medium | low

outputs.name: security_report
outputs.description: { security_score_0to100, findings: [{severity, vuln_type, file, line, fix, cve?}], critical_count, high_count }

side_effects: Caches per-target results; invalidated when target file hashes change

error_codes.message: Target has too many files to scan within the performance budget.
error_codes.recovery: Return partial coverage on first N files; suggest a focused target.

error_codes.message: No security analyzer registered for this file type.
error_codes.recovery: Skip file; list uncovered file types.

examples: target=path/to/deps.json -> finding with cve if match.
